newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy highway food concessionaries to open up.
newsitem.headline: Italy highway food concessionaries to open up.

text.p: Italy's Autostrade Spa and Finanziaria Autogrill have agreed to open up competition for food services on parts of Italy's highway system, the anti-trust Authority said on Saturday.

The agreement was reached after the Authority had warned both companies that they were restricting competition along the some 52 percent of highways run by Autostrade, whose major shareholder is state industrial holdings concern IRI.
The Authority said Autostrade and Autogrill had agreed that Autogrill would cede six of its 83 concessionaries to other companies within 12 months.
Autogrill would not bid for concessions expiring in 2003 and would not make bids for new concessions expected to open up by the year 2001.
The Authority said it was now satisfied that competition would not be restricted. Rome newsroom - 396-678-2501
